working_definition: Author type 'LC10d' of the Özel et al. 2021 optic lobe atlas (Supplementary Table 1).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature form of a lobula columnar neuron (Konstantinides et al., 2022).

justification: 'LC10d' is FBbt:00111748 'lobula columnar neuron LC10d', which has no immature form in FBbt; at P15-P40 the cells are developing (curator: immature terms up to the pupal stage), so the most specific ancestor with an immature form is used: FBbt:00053273 'immature lobula columnar neuron' (as for Kurmangaliyev 2020 early clusters).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Subtype of lobula columnar neuron LC10B. It has its main arbors in lobula layers 4 to 6, with less dense arbors in 5B than in layers 4, 6 or 5A (in contrast to LC10a). Presynaptic sites are observed in layers 4 and 6 (less numerous than LC10a in layer 3 and LC10b in layer 6). Its arbor is much smaller than LC10b. There are around 84 cells of this type.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature form, used from the pharate adult stage; no immature form in FBbt.

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00053273 'immature lobula columnar neuron' (broad match).
